lose.fr: Le sommet se passait bien jusqu'à ce que quelqu'un évoque les cuillères volées. Les pourparlers ont tourné à la bousculade autour de la table : l'un des nôtres a été gardé en otage de bonne volonté. Les autres sont rentrés les tibias et l'amour-propre meurtris.

text.en: Over the last sausage, of course. {c} came out of it with a black eye and a bed in the infirmary.
text.fr: Pour la dernière saucisse, évidemment. {c} en ressort avec un œil au beurre noir et un lit à l'infirmerie.

text.en: Someone slipped into the command tent and made off with a ticket. The guard swears he saw nothing.
text.fr: Quelqu'un s'est glissé sous la tente de commandement et a filé avec un ticket. Le garde jure n'avoir rien vu.

text.en: Purses are lighter this morning, yet nobody remembers being bumped into.
text.fr: Les bourses sont plus légères ce matin. Pourtant, personne ne se souvient d'avoir été bousculé.

text.en: {c} slipped away before dawn, with a blanket and two days of rations.
text.fr: {c} a filé avant l'aube, avec une couverture et deux jours de rations.

text.en: Half the camp spent the night groaning. The worst cases are in the infirmary.
text.fr: La moitié du camp a passé la nuit à gémir. Les cas les plus graves sont à l'infirmerie.

text.en: A lantern tipped over among the storeroom sacks. The fire is out, but what was burned has to be bought again.
text.fr: Une lanterne s'est renversée entre les sacs de la réserve. Le feu est éteint, mais il faut racheter ce qui a été brûlé.

text.en: {c} dug a tunnel with a soup spoon. The spoon has been found, the prisoner has not.
text.fr: {c} a creusé un tunnel avec une cuillère à soupe. On a retrouvé la cuillère, pas le prisonnier.

text.en: The rats ate the cheese, the bread and a boot. Apparently the boot was more popular than the bread.
text.fr: Les rats ont mangé le fromage, le pain et une botte. La botte est apparemment plus appréciée que le pain.

title.en: The tent flattened by the storm
title.fr: La tente abattue par la tempête

text.en: The recruiting tent is on the ground and the candidates went home. New faces will turn up with the next batch of recruits.
text.fr: La tente de recrutement est à terre et les candidats sont rentrés chez eux. De nouvelles têtes viendront au prochain renouvellement.

text.en: The dice came out after supper, and the camp's purse lost every round.
text.fr: On a sorti les dés après le souper. La caisse du camp a perdu toutes les parties.

text.en: The prisoners barricaded their cells and sang all night. So nobody will change sides for another day.
text.fr: Les prisonniers ont barricadé leurs cellules et chanté toute la nuit. Les ralliements attendront donc un jour de plus.

text.en: A fever runs from bed to bed, so every wounded card will take longer to get back on its feet.
text.fr: Une fièvre court de lit en lit. Chaque carte blessée mettra donc plus longtemps à se remettre.

text.en: During drill, a wooden sword turned out to be a real one. {c} found out the hard way and will sit out the next battles.
text.fr: À l'entraînement, une épée de bois s'est révélée bien réelle. {c} l'a appris à ses dépens et ne combattra pas de sitôt.

text.en: Two officers settled a question of seating at dinner. Both won, and both are now in the infirmary.
text.fr: Deux officiers ont réglé une histoire de place à table. Les deux ont gagné et les deux sont maintenant à l'infirmerie.

text.en: The tax collector came with a ledger and a smile, and left with the smile and some of the coins.
text.fr: Le percepteur est arrivé avec un registre et un sourire. Il est reparti avec le sourire et une partie des pièces.

text.en: {c} left a note: "Gone to see my mother, back when the war is over."
text.fr: {c} a laissé un mot : « Je rentre voir ma mère, je reviens à la fin de la guerre. »

text.en: The squad sent on {m} took the wrong valley. It will be back later than planned.
text.fr: L'escouade partie pour {m} s'est trompée de vallée. Elle rentrera plus tard que prévu.

title.en: A spy at the mission board
title.fr: Un espion au tableau des missions

text.en: An enemy spy read the board, and every plan in progress had to be torn up. The missions on offer have changed.
text.fr: Un espion ennemi a lu le tableau et il a fallu déchirer tous les plans en cours. Les missions proposées ont changé.

text.en: A wheel in a ditch, a load in the mud and a farmer to pay back.
text.fr: Une roue dans le fossé, un chargement dans la boue et un fermier à rembourser.

text.en: A ticket fell where nobody will go and look for it.
text.fr: Un ticket est tombé là où personne n'ira le chercher.

text.en: {c} walked up to the gate this morning and asked where to sign.
text.fr: {c} s'est présenté à la porte ce matin pour demander où signer.

text.en: The camp's cooking is nothing without her. {c} joins for the food and asks for no pay.
text.fr: La cuisine du camp n'est rien sans elle. {c} s'engage pour les repas, sans demander de solde.

text.en: Digging new latrines, the sappers hit an old chest full of coins.
text.fr: En creusant de nouvelles latrines, les sapeurs sont tombés sur un vieux coffre rempli de pièces.

text.en: A travelling merchant spent the night at the camp and paid for his supper with a ticket.
text.fr: Un marchand ambulant a passé la nuit au camp. Il a payé son souper avec un ticket.

text.en: Roast, fries and music until late at night. Everybody in the infirmary also got up for it and, sadly, never went back to bed.
text.fr: Rôti, frites et musique jusque tard dans la nuit. Toute l'infirmerie s'est aussi levée pour l'occasion et personne n'est malheureusement retourné se coucher.

text.en: {c} walks out of the infirmary on both legs thanks to a mysterious bowl of secret soup.
text.fr: {c} quitte l'infirmerie sur ses deux jambes grâce à un mystérieux bol de soupe secrète.

text.en: {c} tasted the camp's delicious bread and now demands to change sides at once.
text.fr: {c} a goûté au pain délicieux du camp et exige maintenant de rejoindre nos rangs sur-le-champ.

text.en: An old soldier passing through gave {c} and the soldiers advice all evening. By morning: a promotion!
text.fr: Un vétéran de passage a donné des conseils à {c} et aux soldats toute la soirée. Au réveil : une promotion !

text.en: The mail has arrived! The camp is smiling again and trains twice as hard.
text.fr: Le courrier est arrivé ! Le camp retrouve le sourire et redouble d'ardeur à l'entraînement.

text.en: The camp sold some spare boots and old helmets at a very good price.
text.fr: Le camp a vendu des bottes en trop et de vieux casques à très bon prix.

text.en: {c} fled the red army in the middle of the night and demands a cell and a hot meal.
text.fr: {c} a fui l'armée rouge en pleine nuit pour réclamer une cellule et un repas chaud.

text.en: A pleasant surprise under the boards of the command tent: a super ticket!
text.fr: Une bonne surprise sous les lattes de la tente de commandement : un super ticket !

text.en: The village children came to see the soldiers and gave a sticker for the collection.
text.fr: Les enfants du village sont venus voir les soldats et ont donné un sticker pour la collection.

text.en: Back with new targets, the scouts have updated the mission board.
text.fr: De retour avec de nouvelles cibles, les éclaireurs mettent à jour le tableau des missions.

text.en: The smell of the kitchen drew a crowd. New faces are waiting at the recruiting tent.
text.fr: L'odeur de la cuisine a attiré du monde. De nouvelles têtes attendent à la tente de recrutement.

text.en: The squad sent on {m} came across a shortcut. Its report is waiting for you!
text.fr: L'escouade envoyée sur {m} a dégoté un raccourci. Son rapport t'attend !

text.en: Bright sun, a light wind and no damage at all. The drills were a total success.
text.fr: Grand soleil, vent léger et aucun dégât : les exercices sont un succès total.

text.en: To thank the camp for its protection, the villagers chipped in.
text.fr: Pour remercier le camp de sa protection, les villageois ont cotisé.

text.en: The camp's garden gave more than was needed, and the surplus sold for two tickets.
text.fr: Le potager du camp a donné plus que ce qu'il fallait. Le surplus s'est vendu contre deux tickets.

text.en: A messenger from the capital brought a medal and a promotion for {c}.
text.fr: Un émissaire de la capitale apporte une décoration et une promotion pour {c}.

cast.desc: skinny young man with messy black hair, an oversized dark-blue hood slipping over his eyes, patched plain cloak, holding one small rusty dagger backwards, tiptoeing pose with a nervous grin

lore.en: A kitchen boy who read too many spy novels. He hides behind curtains that are far too short and yet has never once been spotted. Mind you, nobody ever looks at him.
lore.fr: Un commis de cuisine qui a lu trop de romans d'espionnage. Il se cache derrière des rideaux bien trop courts et n'a pourtant jamais été repéré. Il faut dire que personne ne le regarde jamais.

cast.desc: slim young woman with a short auburn bob, a dark-blue scarf over the lower half of her face, simple navy leather outfit, two plain daggers, crouched on one knee and winking

lore.en: Mae learned to vanish in a crowded market by stealing apples. Now she steals battle plans but always leaves an apple core in their place.
lore.fr: Mae a appris à disparaître dans la foule d'un marché en volant des pommes. Aujourd'hui, elle vole des plans de bataille mais laisse toujours un trognon de pomme à leur place.

cast.desc: lean man with slicked-back hair and a thin curled moustache, long dark-blue coat with a high collar, black half-mask, a slender short sword, sidestepping sneakily

lore.en: A master of disguise who owns forty false moustaches and one real one. Nobody, not even Otto, knows which one it is.
lore.fr: Un maître du déguisement qui possède quarante fausses moustaches et une vraie. Personne ne sait jamais laquelle, pas même Otto.

cast.desc: athletic woman with a long black braid, hooded navy cloak with gold trim, fitted blue leather armour, two curved daggers, leaping forward with the cloak flaring

lore.en: Nova slips through enemy lines like smoke up a chimney. She also never leaves empty-handed.
lore.fr: Nova se glisse dans les lignes ennemies comme la fumée dans un conduit de cheminée. Elle ne repart d'ailleurs jamais les mains vides.

cast.desc: dashing man with grey temples and a sharp goatee, elegant black and navy leather coat with gold filigree, a gold-hilted rapier and a hidden wrist blade, bowing theatrically with a sly smile

lore.en: Once the king's pickpocket, now his most trusted blade. He managed to shake the hand of every enemy marshal, then counted his own rings right afterwards.
lore.fr: Jadis pickpocket du roi, aujourd'hui sa lame la plus fidèle. Il a réussi à serrer la main de tous les maréchaux ennemis puis il a recompté ses bagues juste après.

cast.desc: elegant silver-haired woman, hooded navy cloak lined with gold constellations, jewelled blue mask, legendary sapphire dagger glowing blue, two ghostly translucent afterimages of herself behind her

lore.en: No portrait of Shay Dough exists, which makes this one priceless. And for good reason: the last three marshals who saw her face fell in battle.
lore.fr: Il n'existe aucun portrait de Shay Dough, ce qui rend celui-ci inestimable. Et pour cause : les trois derniers maréchaux qui ont vu son visage sont tombés au combat.

cast.desc: freckled young man in a blue tricorn far too big for him, simple blue tunic, a cheap wooden spyglass, standing on tiptoe on a small rock with his tongue out in concentration

lore.en: Seymour climbs every tree he meets to see what is behind it. Usually it is another tree. He catalogues them all anyway.
lore.fr: Seymour grimpe à chaque arbre qu'il croise pour voir ce qu'il y a derrière. En général, un autre arbre. Il les répertorie tous quand même.

cast.desc: lanky young man with sandy hair, blue scarf, short bow on his back, holding a brass spyglass to one eye, balancing on one leg on a fence post

lore.en: His only job is to shout his own name. It took the army a whole week to understand that "Luke Out!" meant "Look out!"
lore.fr: Son seul travail : crier son propre nom. Il a fallu une semaine à l'armée pour comprendre que « Luke Out ! » voulait dire « Attention ! ».

cast.desc: sturdy woman with a red ponytail, blue feathered tricorn, rope coiled over her shoulder, a climbing hook on her belt, peering through a brass telescope

lore.en: Ella Vation climbs anything taller than her to get a better look at the enemy. One day, with no tree in sight, she climbed the colonel, who still does not find it funny.
lore.fr: Ella Vation grimpe sur tout ce qui dépasse pour mieux observer l'ennemi. Un jour, faute d'arbre, elle a escaladé le colonel, qui ne trouve toujours pas ça drôle.

cast.desc: tall dark-skinned woman with short curly hair, long blue ranger coat with gold trim, a long brass telescope, a hawk perched on her leather glove

lore.en: Wanda Far has a hawk called Pip who spots the enemy well in advance and gives Wanda the credit. To be fair, Wanda cooks him one sausage per discovery.
lore.fr: Wanda Far a un faucon, Pip, qui repère l'ennemi à l'avance et donne le mérite à Wanda. Celle-ci, pour être juste, lui cuisine une saucisse par découverte.

cast.desc: weathered bearded man with an eyepatch pushed up on his forehead, ornate blue and gold scout uniform, a map case, kneeling on a rock and pointing ahead with an engraved folding spyglass

lore.en: Rick Onnaissance has scouted every border of the kingdom twice, the second time to check the first. As the two reports match word for word, he is setting off a third time to find out which one is right.
lore.fr: Rick Onnaissance a exploré chaque frontière du royaume deux fois, la seconde pour vérifier la première. Ses deux rapports étant identiques au mot près, il repart une troisième fois pour savoir lequel est le bon.

cast.desc: elderly woman with long white hair braided with blue ribbons, a monocle glowing blue, flowing blue and gold cape, a legendary golden spyglass with a crystal lens, a small owl on her shoulder

lore.en: They say Clara Voyant can guess a card before it is turned over, which she denies, swearing she simply pays attention. Yet nobody will play cards with her any more.
lore.fr: On dit que Clara Voyant devine une carte avant qu'elle soit retournée, ce qu'elle dément en jurant qu'elle observe simplement. Pourtant, personne n'accepte plus de jouer aux cartes avec elle.

cast.desc: young woman with a soot-smudged face and singed brown pigtails, an oversized blue helmet, holding pliers in one hand and a smoking fuse she has not noticed in the other, wide-eyed

lore.en: Dinah Mite always asks a trap nicely not to go off before she defuses it. It has only worked once, so her eyebrows have never quite grown back.
lore.fr: Dinah Mite demande toujours gentiment à un piège de ne pas exploser avant de le désamorcer. Comme ça n'a marché qu'une fois, ses sourcils n'ont jamais fini de repousser.

cast.desc: stocky man with round spectacles, blue tricorn with brass goggles strapped on it, a huge backpack full of tools, carefully snipping a wire on a small round mine with pliers

lore.en: The regiment long made fun of Justin Case's enormous backpack, since he carries a spare of everything. The day a bridge gave way under their feet, he was the only one with a spare rope.
lore.fr: Le régiment s'est longtemps moqué du sac énorme de Justin Case, qui emporte un double de tout. Le jour où un pont a cédé sous leurs pieds, il était le seul à avoir une corde de rechange.

cast.desc: strong woman with black hair tied up in a blue bandana, leather apron with many pouches, a pickaxe on her back, holding a defused round bomb up triumphantly

lore.en: Kay can hear a buried trap tick from twenty paces. She disarms it, keeps the powder and uses it to light the candles on the regiment's birthday cakes.
lore.fr: Kay entend un piège enterré faire tic-tac à vingt pas. Elle le désamorce, garde la poudre et s'en sert pour allumer les bougies d'anniversaire du régiment.

cast.desc: brown-haired man in a blue tricorn with a white feather, heavy backpack with a lantern and rope, crouching over a mine with pliers in one hand and a bundle of dynamite in the other

lore.en: Sol has defused three hundred traps and built four hundred, for practice. He talks to every fuse he cuts, and none has ever answered back.
lore.fr: Sol a désamorcé trois cents pièges et en a fabriqué quatre cents, pour s'entraîner. Il parle à chaque mèche qu'il coupe. Aucune ne lui a encore répondu.

cast.desc: mature woman with short grey-streaked hair and a small burn scar on her cheek, heavy blue and gold armoured apron, brass goggles, holding an ornate defusing kit and a mine-detecting rod

lore.en: Mina walks through minefields humming, and the minefields go quiet. The engineers swear that is not how it works. Mina swears it is.
lore.fr: Quand Mina traverse un champ de mines en fredonnant, les mines se tiennent tranquilles. Les ingénieurs jurent que ça ne marche pas comme ça. Mina jure que si.

cast.desc: old man with a huge white moustache and round cracked goggles, legendary golden armoured sapper suit with blue plates, cradling a glowing blue bomb like a pet, sparks dancing around him

lore.en: Gus Powder has survived so many blasts that the bombs now respect him. So at seventy-two he defuses traps with his eyes shut, often in the middle of a nap.
lore.fr: Gus Powder a survécu à tant d'explosions que les bombes le respectent désormais. À soixante-douze ans, il désamorce donc les pièges les yeux fermés, souvent en pleine sieste.

cast.desc: round-faced young man in a blue tricorn too big for him, a wooden practice sword and a dented plain shield, marching with his knees high and an earnest grin

lore.en: Hugo First believes everything he is told, including the joker who swore to him that scarecrows are spies in disguise. Since then, he has not left a single one standing in the whole kingdom.
lore.fr: Hugo First croit tout ce qu'on lui dit, y compris le farceur qui lui a juré que les épouvantails étaient des espions déguisés. Depuis, il n'en a pas laissé un seul debout dans tout le royaume.

cast.desc: tall young woman with a blonde braid, blue tunic, a round shield with a gold lion, short sword raised, shouting a battle cry mid-stride

lore.en: Marcia Long always marches in a straight line and refuses to go around anything. A scarecrow standing in her way learned that the hard way, as all that is left of it is a hat.
lore.fr: Marcia Long marche toujours tout droit et refuse de contourner quoi que ce soit. Un épouvantail planté sur son chemin l'a appris à ses dépens, puisqu'il n'en reste qu'un chapeau.

cast.desc: broad-shouldered man with black hair under a blue tricorn, a halberd in one hand and a lion shield in the other, a torn straw dummy at his feet

lore.en: Hal once spent a whole night guarding a straw man, waiting for it to move first. At dawn he cut it in half, out of principle.
lore.fr: Hal a passé une nuit entière à surveiller un épouvantail en attendant qu'il bouge le premier. À l'aube, il l'a coupé en deux, par principe.

cast.desc: cheerful blond man in a blue tricorn with a white feather, blue cape with a gold lion, a raised steel sword and a lion shield, big confident smile

lore.en: Frank Lee says exactly what he thinks, and what he thinks is "charge!". His honesty is so complete that no decoy has ever fooled him.
lore.fr: Frank Lee dit exactement ce qu'il pense. Et ce qu'il pense, c'est « Chargez ! ». Il est si franc qu'aucun leurre ne l'a jamais trompé.

cast.desc: muscular woman with cropped grey hair and a square jaw, polished blue and gold breastplate, a sergeant's baton and a sword, standing at attention and saluting

lore.en: Sergeant Sal Ute has been shouting at her recruits from dawn to dusk for three generations. They all complain, but they all come home alive.
lore.fr: La sergente Sal Ute hurle sur ses recrues du matin au soir depuis trois générations. Toutes s'en plaignent mais toutes rentrent en vie.

cast.desc: burly old man with a huge white beard and an eyepatch, gleaming legendary golden armour with a blue lion cape, a giant greatsword planted in the ground, shredded straw dummies around his boots

lore.en: Stan Firm has been a sergeant for fifty years and is proud never to have been promoted. He has cut down more straw men than there are fields in the kingdom.
lore.fr: Sergent depuis cinquante ans, il est fier de n'avoir jamais été promu. Stan Firm a abattu plus d'épouvantails qu'il n'y a de champs dans le royaume.

cast.desc: skinny young man with messy black hair, plain blue tunic, a small hatchet, chopping at a wooden plank with a determined frown

lore.en: Tim, a woodcutter's son, joined the army so he would never cut wood again. On his very first day, they handed him an axe.
lore.fr: Fils de bûcheron, Tim s'est engagé pour ne plus jamais couper de bois. Mais dès le premier jour, l'armée lui a tendu une hache.

cast.desc: cocky young man with spiky brown hair and a blue tricorn, an axe resting on his shoulder, smirking with one boot on a broken fence

lore.en: Axel says the shortest road always goes through the fence. That is why he has not used a gate since he was nine.
lore.fr: Pour Axel, le plus court chemin passe toujours par la palissade. Résultat : il n'a plus franchi un portail depuis ses neuf ans.

cast.desc: woman with black hair in a bun, blue officer coat with gold buttons, swinging a curved battle axe, splinters of wood flying around

lore.en: Holly can fell a palisade in three strokes and rebuild it in four. She calls it redecorating enemy territory.
lore.fr: Holly abat une palissade en trois coups et la reconstruit en quatre. Elle appelle ça redécorer le territoire ennemi.

cast.desc: grinning black-haired man in a blue tricorn with a white plume, blue lion cape, holding a heavy double-bitted axe high above his head

lore.en: Buck Saw has never liked wooden walls, which does not stop him knocking politely at every fence. He only knocks once, with his axe.
lore.fr: Buck Saw n'a jamais aimé les murs de bois, ce qui ne l'empêche pas de frapper poliment à chaque palissade. Il ne frappe qu'une fois, avec sa hache.

cast.desc: sturdy freckled woman with braided red hair, ornate blue and gold officer coat, a hand axe in each hand, wood chips swirling around her

lore.en: Hattie Chet throws her axe the way other officers throw orders, fast and without a second thought. Her soldiers have learned to duck the moment she opens her mouth, which is more than the fences ever did.
lore.fr: Hattie Chet lance sa hache comme d'autres officiers lancent des ordres, vite et sans réfléchir. Ses soldats ont appris à se baisser dès qu'elle ouvre la bouche, contrairement aux palissades.

cast.desc: older man with a long grey braided beard, legendary golden armour with a blue cape, a massive rune-engraved axe glowing blue, a splintered wooden gate behind him

lore.en: Ash Cleaver once split a fortress gate with a single swing, then apologised to the carpenter who built it. Touched, the carpenter joined his regiment to rebuild everything Ash knocks down.
lore.fr: Ash Cleaver a fendu la porte d'une forteresse d'un seul coup de hache puis s'est excusé auprès du charpentier qui l'avait construite. Touché, le charpentier s'est engagé dans son régiment pour reconstruire tout ce qu'Ash abat.

cast.desc: chubby young man with a dirty face and a plain blue cap, a small pickaxe, sitting on a boulder he failed to break, sweating

lore.en: Doug was made captain because he dug trenches faster than anyone. Nobody told him that a captain gives orders instead.
lore.fr: Doug a été nommé capitaine parce qu'il creusait les tranchées plus vite que tout le monde. Personne ne lui a dit qu'un capitaine, ça donne des ordres.

cast.desc: young woman with a brown ponytail, blue captain's coat, a lantern on her belt, cracking a boulder with a miner's pickaxe

lore.en: Gemma Stone grew up in the mines and finds the weak spot in any rock by tapping it twice. She taps her bread too before breaking it, and nobody in the mess dares ask why.
lore.fr: Gemma Stone a grandi dans les mines et trouve la faille d'un rocher en le tapotant deux fois. Elle tapote aussi son pain avant de le rompre et personne au mess n'ose lui demander pourquoi.

cast.desc: rugged stubbled man with his blue coat sleeves rolled up, a heavy pickaxe raised overhead, rock shards flying

lore.en: Cliff has split boulders, cliffs and one very stubborn statue of a general. He keeps a pebble from each in his pockets, which is why he clinks.
lore.fr: Cliff a fendu des rochers, des falaises et une statue de général particulièrement têtue. Il garde un caillou de chacun dans ses poches, d'où ce cliquetis quand il marche.

cast.desc: bald burly man with a thick beard, blue tricorn, broad chest in a blue coat with a lion cape, a giant pickaxe on his shoulder

lore.en: Rocco walks through rocks, not around them. The quartermaster has given up ordering him new pickaxes. Now he orders him new rocks, for practice.
lore.fr: Rocco passe à travers les rochers, pas autour. L'intendant a renoncé à lui commander des pioches neuves. Désormais, il lui commande des rochers neufs, pour l'entraînement.

cast.desc: tall weathered man squinting, grey stubble, long blue duster coat with gold trim, a pickaxe slung over his back like a rifle, chewing a piece of straw

lore.en: Flint Eastwood speaks four words a day and wastes none of them. The rocks hear "move!", and somehow they do.
lore.fr: Flint Eastwood prononce quatre mots par jour et n'en gaspille aucun. Les rochers entendent « Bougez ! » et, allez savoir comment, ils bougent.

cast.desc: tiny elderly woman with a white bun and round glasses, legendary golden captain's armour with a blue cape, a huge crystal-headed pickaxe twice her size glowing blue, a boulder cracked in half behind her

lore.en: Captain Gran Knight already knew how to break mountains before the war had a name. She is small, she is ancient, and no rock in the kingdom dares to stand in her way.
lore.fr: La capitaine Gran Knight savait déjà briser des montagnes quand la guerre n'avait pas encore de nom. Elle est petite, elle est très vieille mais aucun rocher du royaume n'ose lui barrer la route.

cast.desc: confused young man with leaves in his hair, plain blue coat, holding a map upside down and a cheap brass compass

lore.en: Wayne holds his map upside down and still finds the way. No one has ever understood how, and neither has Wayne.
lore.fr: Wayne tient sa carte à l'envers et trouve quand même son chemin. Personne n'a jamais compris comment. Wayne non plus.

cast.desc: young woman with short black hair, blue major's coat, a brass compass on a chain, a walking stick, striding confidently through ferns

lore.en: Tracy leaves chalk arrows on every tree she passes. Enemy scouts follow them for hours and end up reaching their goal.
lore.fr: Tracy trace des flèches à la craie sur chaque arbre qu'elle croise. Les éclaireurs ennemis les suivent pendant des heures et finissent par arriver au but.

cast.desc: fit man with an auburn beard, blue coat, a backpack stuffed with rolled maps, holding a big brass compass and pointing ahead

lore.en: Miles has walked every road of the kingdom and most of the ones that are not there. In a forest he is never the one who is lost. The forest is.
lore.fr: Miles a parcouru toutes les routes du royaume et la plupart de celles qui n'existent pas. Dans une forêt, ce n'est jamais lui qui est perdu : c'est la forêt.

cast.desc: older man with white hair and a neat white beard, blue major's uniform with gold, a large ornate compass in one hand, a sword at his hip, calm smile

lore.en: Major Hector Vane has never been lost, although he once misplaced a regiment for a weekend. They were found exactly where he had left them.
lore.fr: Le major Hector Vane ne s'est jamais perdu, même s'il a égaré un régiment le temps d'un week-end. On l'a retrouvé exactement là où il l'avait laissé.

cast.desc: elegant woman with long dark wavy hair, blue and gold major's coat with a compass-rose brooch, holding a golden compass, cape swirling as if in the wind

lore.en: Rosa Winds once led a whole army through an unknown forest just by following the ants. She got a medal for it, but the ants got nothing.
lore.fr: Rosa Winds a guidé une armée entière à travers une forêt inconnue en suivant simplement le chemin des fourmis. Elle a reçu une médaille pour cet exploit mais les fourmis n'ont rien eu.

cast.desc: very old man with a white beard down to his belt, cloak of blue and gold embroidered with a star map, a legendary golden compass floating and glowing above his palm, a staff topped with a star

lore.en: They say Magnus North drew the first map of the world, then walked it and found only one mistake, a forest in the wrong place. Ever since, that forest parts before him for fear of being corrected.
lore.fr: On dit que Magnus North a dessiné la première carte du monde puis l'a parcourue à pied et n'y a trouvé qu'une erreur, une forêt mal placée. Depuis, cette forêt s'écarte sur son passage, de peur d'être corrigée.

cast.desc: scrappy young man with bandaged knuckles and a bruised cheek, blue coat with torn sleeves, fists raised in a boxing stance, grinning

lore.en: Knox has lost every fight he ever started, and started every fight he ever saw. He is not brave. He simply never learned to be afraid.
lore.fr: Knox a perdu toutes les bagarres qu'il a commencées et commencé toutes celles qu'il a vues. Il n'est pas courageux : il n'a simplement jamais appris à avoir peur.

cast.desc: young woman with short platinum hair, blue colonel's coat, brass knuckle gauntlets, fierce stare, one boot resting on a cracked skull

lore.en: Val Ore was dared to spend a night in the haunted crypt. She came out at dawn with a ghost's hat.
lore.fr: On a mis Val Ore au défi de passer une nuit dans la crypte hantée. Elle en est sortie à l'aube avec le chapeau d'un fantôme.

cast.desc: burly man with a broken nose and curly dark hair, blue coat, steel gauntlets, cracking his knuckles with a confident smirk

lore.en: Colonel Duke Upps settles every argument with one punch, then apologises politely. Skulls, bones and curses do not scare him, but paperwork does.
lore.fr: Le colonel Duke Upps règle chaque dispute d'un seul coup de poing puis s'excuse poliment. Crânes, ossements et malédictions ne l'effraient pas mais la paperasse, si.

cast.desc: long brown-haired man with a full beard, blue colonel's uniform with gold, a lion banner in one hand and an armoured gauntlet fist raised in the other

lore.en: Lionel Hart has crossed the Skull Pass five times whistling, while the skulls rattled their teeth to scare him. By the fifth time, the skulls ended up being afraid of him.
lore.fr: Lionel Hart a traversé cinq fois le col des Crânes en sifflotant, malgré les crânes qui claquaient des dents pour l'effrayer. À la cinquième fois, ce sont les crânes qui finissent par avoir peur de lui.

cast.desc: tall muscular woman with a grey mohawk and a scar across one eye, blue and gold armoured colonel, massive gauntlets, shattering a skull with a punch

lore.en: Mae Hem once punched a cursed skull so hard it apologised. Her regiment follows her anywhere, mostly to see what she will hit next.
lore.fr: Mae Hem a frappé un crâne maudit si fort qu'il s'est excusé. Son régiment la suit partout, surtout pour voir ce qu'elle va frapper ensuite.

cast.desc: gigantic old man, bald with a braided white beard, legendary golden gauntlets glowing blue, blue lion cape, arms crossed, broken skulls at his feet

lore.en: Noah Fear has never been afraid of anything, not even his mother-in-law. When he knocked at the Skull Gate, it was the gate that got scared, and it opened on its own.
lore.fr: Noah Fear n'a jamais eu peur de rien, pas même de sa belle-mère. Quand il a frappé à la porte des Crânes, c'est la porte qui a eu peur et elle s'est ouverte toute seule.

cast.desc: earnest young woman with a neat brown bun, a blue general's coat too big for her, clutching a small padlocked book to her chest

lore.en: Constance swore her oath on a book with a lock, then lost the key. She has kept every promise since, just to be safe.
lore.fr: Constance a prêté serment sur un livre à cadenas puis en a perdu la clé. Depuis, elle tient toutes ses promesses, par précaution.

cast.desc: young man with glasses and neatly parted hair, blue general's coat, a heavy book chained to his wrist, a ring of keys on his belt

lore.en: Keith guards the army's secret orders in a book chained to his wrist. He sleeps with it, eats with it, and once swam a river with it.
lore.fr: Keith garde les ordres secrets de l'armée dans un livre enchaîné à son poignet. Il dort avec, mange avec. Il a même traversé une rivière à la nage avec.

cast.desc: calm woman with short silver-blonde hair, blue general's coat, a sword and a padlocked leather tome on her belt, one hand on her heart

lore.en: Faye Thful has been offered gold, castles and a very nice horse to betray the crown. She kept the horse on principle and refused the rest.
lore.fr: On a offert à Faye Thful de l'or, des châteaux et un très beau cheval pour trahir la couronne. Elle a gardé le cheval par principe et refusé le reste.

cast.desc: woman with long curly red hair, blue tricorn with a white plume, sword raised, a padlocked golden book at her hip, confident smile

lore.en: Ruby Pledge writes down every lie enemy spies have tried on her, and not one has ever worked. That notebook has become her favourite bedtime reading, because nothing makes her laugh more.
lore.fr: Ruby Pledge note dans un carnet chaque mensonge que les espions ennemis ont tenté sur elle, sans qu'aucun ait jamais marché. Ce carnet est devenu sa lecture du soir préférée car rien ne la fait autant rire.

cast.desc: distinguished man with silver hair and a neat moustache, ornate blue and gold general's uniform with medals, a large book sealed with a gold padlock, his hand resting on it

lore.en: General Sterling True has never told a lie, not even to be polite. Yet he keeps a state secret in a book shut with a combination lock. Unable to lie if anyone asks, he chose not to know the combination.
lore.fr: Le général Sterling True n'a jamais menti, même par politesse. Il garde pourtant un secret d'État dans un livre fermé par un cadenas à code. Incapable de mentir si on l'interroge, il a préféré ne pas connaître ce code.

cast.desc: very old dignified woman with silver hair in a crown braid, legendary golden general's armour with a blue mantle, a glowing book floating beside her, bound by golden chains and a padlock

lore.en: Verity Bond has served five kings and betrayed none of them, not even the unbearable one. That is why the secret book entrusted to her has no other lock. Her word is enough, and the book has never been opened.
lore.fr: Verity Bond a servi cinq rois et n'en a trahi aucun, pas même l'insupportable. C'est pourquoi le livre secret qu'on lui a confié n'a pas d'autre serrure. Sa parole suffit et le livre n'a jamais été ouvert.

cast.desc: very young man with an oversized golden crown slipping over his eyes, blue marshal's coat with sleeves too long, a wooden baton, puffing out his chest

lore.en: Kingsley was made marshal because his grandmother was one. He is still growing into the crown, into the coat, and into the job.
lore.fr: Kingsley a été nommé maréchal parce que sa grand-mère l'était. La couronne, le manteau et le poste sont encore un peu grands pour lui.

cast.desc: young woman with blonde curls and a small crown, blue marshal's coat with gold braid, a marshal's baton, hand on her hip in a commanding pose

lore.en: Regina gives orders so confidently that people obey before they notice she is not their officer. Sometimes she is not even in the army.
lore.fr: Regina donne des ordres avec une telle assurance que les soldats obéissent avant de remarquer qu'elle n'est pas leur officier. Parfois, elle n'est même pas dans l'armée.

cast.desc: muscular man with slicked-back black hair and a gold circlet, blue marshal's greatcoat, sword raised as he leads a charge

lore.en: Max Power believes every problem can be solved with a louder speech. He is right more often than the generals would like to admit.
lore.fr: Max Power pense que tout problème se règle avec un discours plus fort. Il a raison plus souvent que les généraux ne voudraient l'admettre.

cast.desc: slender blond man with a small golden crown, white and blue marshal's coat with gold epaulettes, pointing forward with a golden baton, noble expression

lore.en: Marshal Victor Ious has won so many battles that he now loses the odd game of cards on purpose, to stay humble. It does not work.
lore.fr: Le maréchal Victor Ious a gagné tant de batailles qu'il perd exprès quelques parties de cartes pour rester humble. Peine perdue.

cast.desc: regal woman with long dark hair streaked with grey, tall golden crown set with sapphires, blue and gold ceremonial armour, ermine-trimmed cape, marshal's baton raised

lore.en: Reigna Supreme commands from the front, crown on and cape dragging in the mud. She says a crown that has never been dented is just a hat.
lore.fr: Reigna Supreme commande en première ligne, couronne sur la tête et cape traînant dans la boue. Elle dit qu'une couronne jamais cabossée n'est qu'un chapeau.

cast.desc: very old king-like man with long white hair and beard, legendary giant golden crown glowing, blue and gold royal armour, ermine cape, a golden lion sceptre, a spectral golden lion behind him

lore.en: Rex Maximus has not lost a single battle in sixty years of command, but his grandchildren beat him at chess every Sunday. He suspects the red army of giving them lessons.
lore.fr: Rex Maximus n'a perdu aucune bataille en soixante ans de commandement mais ses petits-enfants le battent aux échecs tous les dimanches. Il soupçonne l'armée rouge de leur donner des leçons.

cast.desc: tiny scrawny imp girl with big red eyes, an oversized red hood swallowing her, a tiny rusty dagger, peeking out from behind her own cape

lore.en: Ima Lurker is so small she vanishes inside her own hood, which makes her the red army's ideal spy. But so far she has brought back three spoons and a sock.
lore.fr: Ima Lurker est si petite qu'elle disparaît dans sa propre capuche, ce qui en fait l'espionne idéale de l'armée rouge. Mais pour l'instant, elle a rapporté trois cuillères et une chaussette.

cast.desc: lean imp with spiky black hair and a red scarf mask, simple black leather, two jagged daggers, crouched on top of a crate

lore.en: Mort keeps a tally of every tent he has sneaked into, scratched with his own dagger. The dagger is getting shorter and shorter.
lore.fr: Mort compte chaque tente où il s'est faufilé en gravant une encoche avec sa dague. La dague raccourcit de plus en plus.

cast.desc: slender dark-elf woman with a long red ponytail, black and red leather, a curved dagger dripping green poison, a grin with too many fangs

lore.en: Vi Perr smiles with too many teeth and whispers with a forked tongue, so nobody in the red army trusts her. For a spy, that is the finest compliment there is.
lore.fr: Vi Perr sourit avec trop de dents et chuchote avec une langue fourchue, si bien que personne dans l'armée rouge ne lui fait confiance. Pour une espionne, c'est le plus beau des compliments.

cast.desc: hooded imp whose red eyes glow in the shadow of a black and red hood, crimson face mask, twin serrated daggers, lunging from a crouch

lore.en: Hal O'Ween has slipped into the blue camp three times dressed as a pumpkin without ever being spotted. The fourth time was in autumn, and a cook very nearly made soup out of him.
lore.fr: Hal O'Ween s'est glissé trois fois dans le camp bleu, déguisé en citrouille, sans jamais être repéré. La quatrième fois, c'était l'automne et un cuisinier a bien failli en faire une soupe.

cast.desc: elegant dark-elf woman with white hair in a sharp bob, ornate black and red assassin armour with gold filigree, poison vials on her belt, twin golden daggers, sly smile

lore.en: Bella Donna poisons with charm first and daggers second. That is why her invitations to tea are the most feared letters in the blue army.
lore.fr: Bella Donna empoisonne d'abord avec son charme, ensuite avec ses dagues. C'est pourquoi ses invitations à prendre le thé sont les lettres les plus redoutées de l'armée bleue.

cast.desc: ancient hunched imp with a long white beard, legendary black and gold cloak dissolving into smoke, a glowing crimson dagger, burning red eyes, ghostly shadow hands curling around him

lore.en: Mortimer Dread has already died once and found it so boring that he came back as a shadow. Ever since, every blue marshal sleeps with a candle lit.
lore.fr: Mortimer Dread est déjà mort une fois et a trouvé ça si ennuyeux qu'il est revenu sous la forme d'une ombre. Depuis, tous les maréchaux bleus dorment avec une bougie allumée.

cast.desc: tiny imp girl squinting one huge red eye through a cracked red monocle, oversized red cap, holding a spyglass made from a cardboard tube

lore.en: Iris Squint squints so hard at the enemy that she gives herself headaches. That did not stop her once reporting an army that was only a row of mushrooms.
lore.fr: Iris Squint plisse tellement les yeux pour observer l'ennemi qu'elle en a la migraine. Ça ne l'a pas empêchée de signaler un jour une armée qui n'était qu'une rangée de champignons.

cast.desc: gangly goblin-like imp with huge ears, red hood, short bow on his back, standing on tiptoe on a dead stump with a hand shading his eyes

lore.en: Ogle's ears are even better than his eyes. He hears the blue army's boots a league away, and the opponents' snoring from two.
lore.fr: Les oreilles d'Ogle sont encore meilleures que ses yeux. Il entend les bottes de l'armée bleue à une lieue et les ronflements des adversaires à deux lieues.

cast.desc: dark-elf woman with black feathered hair, red cloak trimmed with crow feathers, a spyglass carved from bone, a crow perched on her shoulder

lore.en: Every evening, Raven Crowley's crows tell her who snores and who cheats at cards in the blue camp. The blue colonel, who does both, has not left his tent since.
lore.fr: Les corbeaux de Raven Crowley lui racontent chaque soir qui ronfle et qui triche aux cartes dans le camp bleu. Le colonel bleu, qui fait les deux, ne sort plus de sa tente depuis.

cast.desc: imp with a huge red feather crest, red and gold light armour, drawing a jagged longbow, glowing red eyes taking aim

lore.en: Bo Stringer can put an arrow through a keyhole from a hundred paces, so the blue officers now plug their keyholes with wax. Since then, none of them can open their own doors.
lore.fr: Bo Stringer peut planter une flèche dans un trou de serrure à cent pas, si bien que les officiers bleus bouchent désormais leurs serrures à la cire. Depuis, aucun d'eux n'arrive plus à ouvrir sa porte.

cast.desc: tall dark-elf woman with silver hair streaked red, a third red eye glowing on her forehead, ornate red and gold scout armour, holding a crystal spyglass

lore.en: Morgana Gaze painted a third eye on her forehead as a joke, and then it opened. Now nothing hidden stays hidden on any battlefield she looks at.
lore.fr: Morgana Gaze s'est peint un troisième œil sur le front pour rire. Puis il s'est ouvert. Depuis, rien ne reste caché sur un champ de bataille qu'elle regarde.

cast.desc: ancient imp elder with long white eyebrows, a legendary golden headdress set with a giant glowing red crystal eye, small floating eyeballs orbiting him, a golden telescope staff

lore.en: I.C. Everything has watched this war since before it started. He sees through fog, walls and lies. Nothing surprises him any more, so this war bores him terribly.
lore.fr: I.C. Everything observait déjà cette guerre avant qu'elle commence. Il voit à travers le brouillard, les murs et les mensonges. Plus rien ne l'étonne, si bien que cette guerre l'ennuie à mourir.

cast.desc: small imp with singed smoking hair, a dented red helmet, holding a sputtering tiny round bomb with a worried grin

lore.en: Fizzle Wickett's bombs never go off when they should, and always go off when they should not. So the red army makes him pitch his tent far from everyone, on the other side of the river.
lore.fr: Les bombes de Fizzle Wickett n'explosent jamais quand il faut et toujours quand il ne faut pas. L'armée rouge lui fait donc planter sa tente loin de tout le monde, de l'autre côté de la rivière.

cast.desc: imp girl with sooty red pigtails, red apron with pockets full of black powder, a round bomb in each hand, cheeky fanged grin, one shoe missing

lore.en: Cinder Ella lost a shoe in every explosion she ever caused. She owns forty left shoes but lives in hope.
lore.fr: Cinder Ella a perdu une chaussure à chaque explosion qu'elle a provoquée. Elle possède quarante chaussures gauches mais garde espoir.

cast.desc: stocky goblin-like imp with brass goggles, red coat, a big alarm-clock bomb strapped to his back, pliers and coloured wires in hand

lore.en: Tick Tockley builds bombs that play a little tune before they go off. He says it is only polite to warn people.
lore.fr: Tick Tockley fabrique des bombes qui jouent un petit air avant d'exploser. Pour lui, prévenir les gens, c'est la moindre des politesses.

cast.desc: grinning imp with a red plumed helmet and goggles, red and gold armour, holding a lit round bomb, a bundle of dynamite on his belt and a small shovel

lore.en: Barry D. Alive digs traps, covers them with care, then forgets where he put them. So the whole red army walks on tiptoe, just in case.
lore.fr: Barry D. Alive creuse des pièges, les recouvre avec soin puis oublie où il les a mis. Toute l'armée rouge marche donc sur la pointe des pieds, au cas où.

cast.desc: dark-elf woman with wild white hair standing on end, red and gold demolition armour, glass vials of glowing red liquid on bandoliers, a detonator plunger

lore.en: Nitro Glyss always hums while she mixes her powders. From now on, the moment a song drifts in from the red side, the blue sappers throw themselves flat on the ground.
lore.fr: Nitro Glyss fredonne toujours quand elle mélange ses poudres. Désormais, dès qu'une chanson arrive du côté rouge, les sapeurs bleus se jettent à plat ventre par terre.

cast.desc: ancient imp with a huge white moustache and a monocle, legendary golden and crimson armour, sitting on a giant glowing red bomb like a throne, holding a lit fuse like a cigar

lore.en: Baron Von Kaboom lights his pipe straight from the fuses of his bombs. He remembers to blow the fuse out afterwards... well, most of the time.
lore.fr: Le baron Von Kaboom allume sa pipe directement sur les mèches de ses bombes. Il pense à souffler la mèche ensuite... enfin la plupart du temps.

cast.desc: pudgy imp in a red helmet too big for him, a rusty short sword, tripping over his own cape

lore.en: Grunt Mudworth is the easiest recruit in the red army to fool. Yet he does not fall for scarecrows and attacks them on sight because they look shifty.
lore.fr: Grunt Mudworth est la recrue la plus facile à duper de l'armée rouge. Pourtant, il ne se laisse pas avoir par les épouvantails et les attaque à vue parce qu'ils ont l'air louche.

cast.desc: sturdy imp woman with braided red hair, dented red breastplate, a notched sword, snarling fiercely

lore.en: Snarla Grit has never understood a joke, a trick or a decoy. So when she sees a scarecrow, she sees an enemy to knock down.
lore.fr: Snarla Grit n'a jamais compris une blague, une ruse ou un leurre. Quand elle voit un épouvantail, elle voit donc un ennemi à abattre.

cast.desc: tough imp woman with spiky red hair, spiked red armour with barbed wire wrapped around her forearms, a sword and a spiked shield

lore.en: Barb Wire hugs her recruits once a year, and they all dread that day. Mind you, those are the same arms that tear scarecrows apart like paper.
lore.fr: Barb Wire serre ses recrues dans ses bras une fois par an et toutes redoutent ce jour. Il faut dire qu'avec ces mêmes bras, elle déchire les épouvantails comme du papier.

cast.desc: laughing imp with eyes squeezed shut, red and gold plumed hat, raising a jagged sword, red cape flowing

lore.en: Chuck Le laughs at everything: orders, danger, his own reflection. He laughed so hard at the blue scarecrows that he cut them all down by accident.
lore.fr: Chuck Le rit de tout : des ordres, du danger, de son propre reflet. Il a tellement ri des épouvantails bleus qu'il les a tous abattus par accident.

cast.desc: tall muscular imp woman with a grey buzz cut and a scar, ornate spiked red and gold sergeant's armour, a big serrated falchion, a whistle around her neck

lore.en: Ruth Less inspects everything each morning, from her recruits' boots to the scarecrows on the battlefield. No scarecrow has ever passed her inspection.
lore.fr: Ruth Less inspecte tout chaque matin, des bottes de ses recrues aux épouvantails du champ de bataille. Aucun épouvantail n'a jamais réussi son inspection.

cast.desc: huge old imp with a long white braided beard and small tusks, legendary gold and crimson armour, a giant flaming cleaver, burning straw dummies behind him

lore.en: Gore Don, with his powerful voice, trained the red soldiers. It is also worth noting that one of his bellows can flatten a whole field of straw men.
lore.fr: Gore Don, avec sa voix puissante, a formé les soldats rouges. Il faut noter aussi qu'un seul de ses rugissements suffit à coucher un champ entier d'épouvantails.

cast.desc: skinny imp with spiky blond hair and splinters in it, plain red tunic, a cracked hatchet, eager grin

lore.en: Hackett chops everything that looks wooden: fences, doors... and even, once, the colonel's leg. They have not spoken since that day.
lore.fr: Hackett coupe tout ce qui ressemble à du bois : palissades, portes... et même une fois la jambe du colonel. Ils ne se parlent plus depuis ce jour.

cast.desc: imp woman with a messy blond ponytail, red tunic, dragging a notched battle axe behind her, smirking

lore.en: Axelle Rott drags her axe everywhere, so the whole red army hears her coming. The blue fences hear it too, and start to shake.
lore.fr: Axelle Rott traîne sa hache partout, si bien que toute l'armée rouge l'entend arriver. Les palissades bleues l'entendent aussi et se mettent à trembler.

cast.desc: wolfish imp with a grey fur collar, red and black armour, a double-bladed axe, sharp fangs bared, a splintered palisade stake beside him

lore.en: Timber Wolfe howls before he chops. Nobody has told him it spoils the surprise, because nobody wants to be chopped.
lore.fr: Timber Wolfe hurle avant de frapper. Personne ne lui a dit que ça gâche la surprise, parce que personne ne veut être coupé en deux.

cast.desc: imp woman with spiky blond hair, red and gold plumed lieutenant's hat, fierce fanged grin, a heavy bearded axe raised and a round red shield

lore.en: Sally Splinters built a throne out of every fence she ever broke. This royal seat is terribly uncomfortable, yet she sits on it every day, out of pride.
lore.fr: Sally Splinters s'est bâti un trône avec toutes les palissades qu'elle a brisées. Ce siège royal est affreusement inconfortable mais elle s'y assoit tous les jours, par fierté.

cast.desc: broad imp with a black beard in braids, ornate red and gold armour, twin hand axes with glowing red edges, wood chips flying

lore.en: Hew Gore keeps the best splinter of every fence he knocks down as a toothpick. His collection holds over three hundred toothpicks, though he has only two teeth left.
lore.fr: Hew Gore garde la plus belle écharde de chaque palissade qu'il abat pour s'en faire un cure-dent. Sa collection compte plus de trois cents cure-dents, alors qu'il ne lui reste que deux dents.

cast.desc: tiny ancient imp woman with a white hair bun and knitting needles in it, legendary gold and crimson armour, a massive glowing executioner's axe far bigger than her

lore.en: Granny Guillotine knits in the evening and chops down fences in the morning. Her knitting needles are carved from their splinters, so nothing goes to waste.
lore.fr: Granny Guillotine tricote le soir et abat des palissades le matin. Ses aiguilles à tricoter sont taillées dans leurs échardes, pour ne rien gâcher.

cast.desc: stubby goblin-like imp in an oversized red miner's helmet with a candle on it, a tiny pickaxe, sitting on a rock and sulking

lore.en: Pebble has been hitting the same rock for three weeks. The rock is winning, but Pebble has promised it a rematch.
lore.fr: Pebble frappe le même rocher depuis trois semaines. Le rocher mène mais Pebble lui a promis une revanche.

cast.desc: dust-covered imp woman with a red bandana, red miner's coat, a pickaxe over her shoulder, grinning with a chipped fang

lore.en: Gerty Gravel tells the recruits she eats pebbles to keep her teeth sharp. Since the recruits tried it too, the red army's dentist has never been so busy.
lore.fr: Gerty Gravel raconte aux recrues qu'elle mange des cailloux pour garder les dents pointues. Depuis que les recrues ont essayé aussi, le dentiste de l'armée rouge n'a jamais eu autant de travail.

cast.desc: hulking bald goblin-like imp with bare arms and red armour plates, a heavy iron pickaxe, cracking a boulder

lore.en: Rock Bottom has hit rocks so often he has become a bit like one: slow to move, hard to stop, and very difficult to lift.
lore.fr: Rock Bottom a tant frappé de rochers qu'il a fini par leur ressembler : lent à se mettre en route, dur à arrêter et très difficile à soulever.

cast.desc: imp woman with long flowing red hair, red and gold plumed captain's hat, fierce fanged grin, a war pickaxe held high

lore.en: Captain Scarlett Quarry sings to the rocks before she breaks them. Most of them crack on the high notes, which saves her a lot of swinging.
lore.fr: La capitaine Scarlett Quarry chante pour les rochers avant de les briser. La plupart se fendent dans les aigus, ce qui lui épargne bien des coups.

cast.desc: tall imp with black stone-like tattoos, ornate red and gold armour, a pickaxe with a glowing obsidian head, cracked rocks around him

lore.en: Obi Sidian's pickaxe was carved from a volcano's heart. It talks a lot while it works, and rocks crumble just to make it stop.
lore.fr: La pioche d'Obi Sidian a été taillée dans le cœur d'un volcan. Elle parle beaucoup en travaillant. Les rochers s'effritent rien que pour la faire taire.

cast.desc: ancient hunched imp woman with white hair and a crystal-studded crown, legendary gold and crimson armour, a colossal jewelled pickaxe glowing red, sitting on a split pile of gems

lore.en: Mother Lode has dug through more mountains than this war has soldiers. The rocks of the red country call her grandmother, and step aside when she asks.
lore.fr: Mother Lode a percé plus de montagnes que cette guerre ne compte de soldats. Les rochers du pays rouge l'appellent grand-mère et s'écartent quand elle le demande.

cast.desc: skinny imp tangled in a map, leaves in his hair, plain red coat, a cracked compass spinning wildly in his hand

lore.en: Wendell's compass points wherever he is not. He trusts it completely, and as a result has visited the whole red country by accident.
lore.fr: La boussole de Wendell indique toujours là où il n'est pas. Il lui fait une confiance aveugle et de ce fait a visité tout le pays rouge par accident.

cast.desc: imp woman with moss-green streaks in her hair, hooded red coat with twigs caught in it, a bone compass on a string, sniffing the air

lore.en: Fern finds her way by the smell of the moss. The forest tried to swallow her once, and spat her out for being too clever.
lore.fr: Fern trouve son chemin à l'odeur de la mousse. La forêt a essayé de l'avaler une fois puis l'a recrachée : elle était trop maligne.

cast.desc: imp with long pointed ears, red greatcoat with many pockets, a brass compass and a lantern, marching with a walking stick

lore.en: Trek Morrow has walked into the Black Forest nine times and back out eight. Nobody asks about the ninth.
lore.fr: Trek Morrow est entré neuf fois dans la Forêt Noire et en est ressorti huit fois. Personne ne pose de question sur la neuvième.

cast.desc: old dark-elf woman with white hair in a high bun and gold-rimmed glasses, red and gold robes, a golden compass in one hand and an old map book in the other

lore.en: Major Marga Gellan has charted every wood of the red country and scolded most of them. Trees are said to straighten their branches when she walks by.
lore.fr: La major Marga Gellan a cartographié chaque bois du pays rouge et en a sermonné la plupart. On dit que les arbres redressent leurs branches à son passage.

cast.desc: tall dark-elf man with long black hair and a silver streak, ornate red and gold major's armour, a golden compass spinning in the air above his hand, cape embroidered with a star chart

lore.en: Merid Ian navigates by the stars, even at noon. He simply knows where they are. No forest has ever kept him longer than a lunch break.
lore.fr: Merid Ian se guide aux étoiles, même à midi : il sait simplement où elles sont. Aucune forêt ne l'a jamais retenu plus longtemps qu'une pause déjeuner.

cast.desc: ancient dark-elf woman with floor-length white hair, legendary golden crown shaped like compass points, crimson robes embroidered with maps, a giant glowing compass rose floating behind her

lore.en: Lady Longitude drew the borders of the red country with her own quill. Forests that are not on her maps are not allowed to exist, and many have quietly stopped.
lore.fr: Lady Longitude a tracé les frontières du pays rouge de sa propre plume. Les forêts absentes de ses cartes n'ont pas le droit d'exister. Beaucoup ont eu la politesse de disparaître.

cast.desc: scrawny imp with a black eye, red headband, oversized red boxing gloves, bouncing in a fighting stance

lore.en: Scrappy Doolittle challenges everyone to a duel, even the wind. The wind has beaten him twice, but Scrappy says the wind cheated.
lore.fr: Scrappy Doolittle provoque tout le monde en duel, y compris le vent. Le vent l'a battu deux fois mais d'après Scrappy, le vent a triché.

cast.desc: imp woman with white pigtails, torn red coat, spiked red knuckle-dusters, fanged grin, cracking a skull with one punch

lore.en: Brawla Fang keeps a skull on her bedside table and says good morning to it every day. The skull has never answered, which she finds very rude.
lore.fr: Brawla Fang garde un crâne sur sa table de nuit et lui dit bonjour chaque matin. Le crâne ne lui a jamais répondu, ce qu'elle trouve très impoli.

cast.desc: burly goblin-like imp with a shaved head and small tusks, red and black armour, iron gauntlets, one foot on a pile of skulls

lore.en: Mack Maul fears nothing except running out of things to punch. One day he punched a ghost, which left the country the very next morning.
lore.fr: Mack Maul ne craint rien, sauf de manquer de choses à frapper. Un jour, il a cogné un fantôme, qui a quitté le pays dès le lendemain.

cast.desc: imp woman with long wild white hair, red and gold plumed armour, massive spiked gauntlets, snarling, a smashed skull under her boot

lore.en: Colonel Blanche Fury went white overnight, not from fright but from anger. Ever since, she has taken that anger out on the blue army's cursed skulls, and cracked every one of them.
lore.fr: La colonelle Blanche Fury a blanchi en une nuit, non pas de peur mais de colère. Depuis, elle passe sa colère sur les crânes maudits de l'armée bleue et les a tous fendus.

cast.desc: towering bald imp with red war paint shaped like a skull on his face, ornate red and gold armour, huge glowing red gauntlets, fist raised

lore.en: Crusher Morgue paints a skull on his face so the real ones know who is in charge. He punches even those who want to argue with him.
lore.fr: Crusher Morgue se peint un crâne sur le visage pour que les vrais sachent qui commande. Il frappe même ceux qui veulent discuter avec lui.

cast.desc: gigantic ancient imp with a long white beard braided with small bones, legendary gold and crimson armour, colossal fiery gauntlets, a heap of broken skulls behind him

lore.en: Dread Naught fears nothing, because he is what everyone fears. At eighty-eight he still opens Skulls with a single knock.
lore.fr: Dread Naught ne craint rien car c'est lui que tout le monde craint. À quatre-vingt-huit ans, il ouvre encore des Crânes d'un seul coup de poing.

cast.desc: small imp girl in a red beret, carrying a huge padlocked book she can barely lift, keys jingling on her belt, determined pout

lore.en: Penny Padlock was handed one of the red army's secret books with orders never to open it. Penny obeys to the letter and only uses it to prop up the wobbly leg of her bed.
lore.fr: On a confié à Penny Padlock un livre secret de l'armée rouge avec l'ordre de ne jamais l'ouvrir. Penny obéit à la lettre et s'en sert seulement pour caler le pied bancal de son lit.

cast.desc: bookish imp with round spectacles, red general's coat, a chained book on his belt, a quill behind his pointed ear

lore.en: Tomas Tome knows the red army's secret book by heart. When blue spies question him, he recites a recipe for turnip soup.
lore.fr: Tomas Tome connaît par cœur le livre secret de l'armée rouge. Quand les espions bleus l'interrogent, il leur récite une recette de soupe aux navets.

cast.desc: dark-elf woman with dark braids wrapped in chains, red and black general's coat, a heavy book sealed with red wax and a padlock, stern look

lore.en: Bonnie Bound keeps her promises like nobody else. When the blue army offered her a castle for her secret book, she replied with a letter locked by three padlocks that nobody has ever managed to open.
lore.fr: Bonnie Bound respecte ses promesses comme personne. Quand l'armée bleue lui a offert un château contre son livre secret, elle a répondu par une lettre fermée de trois cadenas que personne n'a jamais pu ouvrir.

cast.desc: massive imp in heavy red and gold armour, ferocious grin, gauntleted fist raised, a huge padlocked tome chained to his back

lore.en: General Garth Sworn swore loyalty to the red crown with his fist on the book. The old book is now dented, but he has never broken his word.
lore.fr: Le général Garth Sworn a juré fidélité à la couronne rouge, le poing sur le livre. Le bouquin est maintenant cabossé mais il n'a jamais trahi sa parole.

cast.desc: tall dark-elf woman with silver hair in an elegant crown braid, ornate red and gold general's armour with medals, carrying a golden padlocked grimoire, commanding gaze

lore.en: Fidelia Chains has refused every bribe with the same smile and the same sentence: "The book stays shut." Some say the book itself obeys her.
lore.fr: Fidelia Chains a refusé chaque pot-de-vin avec le même sourire et la même phrase : « Le livre reste fermé ». Certains disent que le livre lui-même lui obéit.

cast.desc: ancient imp elder with a long white beard, legendary gold and crimson armour, a giant floating tome locked with glowing red chains and a golden skull-shaped padlock

lore.en: Ever Sworn has kept the red country's oldest secret for seventy years. He has forgotten his birthday and even his own name. Here is proof that secrets will stay well kept.
lore.fr: Ever Sworn garde le plus vieux secret du pays rouge depuis soixante-dix ans. Il a oublié son anniversaire et même son nom. Voici une preuve que les secrets resteront bien gardés.

cast.desc: tiny imp boy with a huge red crown sliding over his eyes, red cape dragging on the ground, a wooden sceptre, pouting

lore.en: Pip Squeak is next in line for the red throne, but only after forty-two cousins. So he practises his royal wave.
lore.fr: Pip Squeak est l'héritier du trône rouge mais juste après quarante-deux cousins. Il s'entraîne donc à faire le salut royal.

cast.desc: imp girl with red curls and a small spiky crown, red and gold gown over light armour, stamping her foot and pointing a sceptre

lore.en: Tiara Tantrum gives every order twice, the second time much louder. Nobody knows what would happen on the third, and nobody wants to find out.
lore.fr: Tiara Tantrum donne chaque ordre deux fois, la seconde beaucoup plus fortement. Personne ne sait ce qui arriverait à la troisième et personne ne tient à le découvrir.

cast.desc: tall imp noble with slicked black hair and a widow's peak, high-collared red and black cape, a spiky crown, sly fanged smile

lore.en: Count Less has so many titles he has lost count. He introduces himself for twenty minutes before every battle, which is, in fact, his strategy.
lore.fr: Count Less a tant de titres qu'il en a perdu le compte. Avant chaque bataille, il décline ses titres pendant vingt minutes. C'est, en réalité, sa stratégie.

cast.desc: old imp with a white beard and gold glasses, a tall red and gold crown-hat, red robes, red magic swirling from one hand, a ledger book in the other

lore.en: Mordred Monarch rules the red army with a spell in one hand and a ledger in the other. He knows the value of every soldier but the name of none.
lore.fr: Mordred Monarch dirige l'armée rouge avec un sort dans une main et un registre dans l'autre. Il connaît la valeur de chaque soldat mais le nom d'aucun.

cast.desc: imposing dark-elf queen with long black hair streaked white, a tall jagged crimson crown set with rubies, red and gold ceremonial armour, bat-wing cape, a sceptre with a glowing gem

lore.en: Vexa Throne took the crown at a banquet, and nobody remembers how. Her smile is so cold that nobody dares to ask.
lore.fr: Vexa Throne a pris la couronne pendant un banquet et personne ne se souvient comment. Son sourire est si froid que personne n'ose le lui demander.

cast.desc: ancient towering imp emperor with a very long white beard, legendary colossal golden crown with a burning red gem, crimson and gold robes, a skull sceptre, red flames and bats swirling around him

lore.en: Rex Mortis has worn the red crown so long that it has grown into his head. Every blue spy dreams of stealing it, but they would have to carry off Rex Mortis too.
lore.fr: Rex Mortis porte la couronne rouge depuis si longtemps qu'elle a fini par pousser dans sa tête. Les espions bleus rêvent tous de la lui voler mais il faudrait emporter Rex Mortis avec.
